description: Return the arcsine, in radians from -#pi/2 to #pi/2, of the <dataType> value, as ECMAScript Math.asin does. A value outside -1.0 to 1.0 is an error. A result that would be NaN, or a NaN argument, is an error. An integer is not accepted: write to_double(v).

errorsThrown.reason: the result would be NaN, or an operand is NaN
